reason: This PR changes core planner rewrite logic for semi joins during predicate pushdown in `logical_join.go` and `rule_semi_join_rewrite.go`. Semi-join transformations are optimizer-semantic changes with meaningful blast radius: they can alter query results, null/exists semantics, decorrelation behavior, and plan selection across many queries. Even with only two code paths changed, this is central planner logic rather than a routine local fix, so it merits a focused deep review for correctness regressions.
